description: This Java class defines a REST controller named HealthController in a Spring Boot application. It provides a single endpoint '/healthz' for health checks, returning a JSON object with status, timestamp, and service name. The class is annotated for Swagger documentation and Spring's REST controller functionality.

classes.name: HealthController
classes.description: A Spring Boot REST controller providing a health check endpoint at '/healthz' that returns a JSON response indicating service health status, timestamp, and service name.

methods.name: healthz
methods.description: Handles GET requests to '/healthz', returning a JSON object with 'status', 'timestamp', and 'service' keys indicating health status of the application.
